scope_amendment: User requested only A2; A0 frozen replay and A2 five Development folds/interventions authorized. A1/A3/A4 training NOT_RUN_USER_SCOPE. No new Outer.
frozen_base: Exact D1 R14, duplicate-aware 88-position LN semantics, original FIT-only imputer/scaler, own-fold BEST; no retraining
window_delta: Pinned original float32 physiology on genuine unnormalized 500-sample Raw250; all genuine centers<0 mean reference; full-view float32 reduction layout preserved for R14; no filters, upsampling, new bands, or onset certainty claims

parity.R14_absolute_tolerance: 8 float32 ULP at absolute reference coordinate

conditioning_scale.estimator: Median of per-patient median absolute DELTA, using all genuine available windows/channels/seizures per FIT patient. Each FIT patient contributes exactly one magnitude estimate per family; median across FIT patients. Not a pooled-window median.

architecture.CNN: Conv1d1to12 k9 s4 GELU Conv1d12to24 k7 s4 GELU AdaptiveAvgPool1d1
architecture.latent_reference: all genuine center<0 mean, same seizure/channel
architecture.gate: Linear7to32 GELU Linear32to24, last weight/bias zero
architecture.within_seizure: masked means [0,8) and [8,20); no sequence encoder
architecture.patient_z: float64 across valid canonical channels, SD<=1e-8 denominator1, then float32
architecture.head: Linear96to64 GELU Linear64to1

training.objective: Original FIT NEZ-positive class-weighted BCE(final)+0.25*BCE(raw), channel mean then one update per FIT patient
training.selection: Validation patient MacroF1, EZF1, earlier epoch; original NEZ0:0.005:1 grid and exact tie rules

controls.shuffle: SHA256(seed42,patient,compound seizure key,canonical channel,stage) RNG permutation; move full7-vector, force nonidentity if >=2 eligible; no Raw/time/reference/mask changes
controls.static: Within seizure/channel/stage mean of raw physiological DELTA, repeat then apply same fixed normalization
controls.intervention_threshold: Always selected A2 threshold, including residual-disabled D1 replay

bootstrap.clusters: 47 unique patient IDs retaining all65 appearances

full_scientific_gate: NOT_EVALUABLE_UNRUN_MATCHED_CONTROLS; no DGM_NET_DEVELOPMENT_PROMISING terminal without A1/A3/A4 trained contrasts
publish: Source/protocol hashes and anonymous aggregates only; raw/IDs/labels/banks/checkpoints/predictions/logs private on original server
